title: Calling the Spring Boot API from FastAPI: service URL, token and timeouts

objectives.text: Call the Spring Boot API from a FastAPI route with httpx, reading the service base URL and bearer token from settings loaded from environment variables
Set explicit timeouts and turn a timeout, connection error or non-2xx upstream response into a clear error response from your own API
Test the outbound call without a running Spring Boot service by using an httpx mock transport

The fastapi-services module PR replaces modeledP50 with the frozen estimator P50 (workflow/tools/timing/estimate_reading.py, sha256 0deca96bf5e367aeae51a82abdbd4b6ce0d0289ecc9868c9eff3701016edf96f) on the authored bytes, re-models the worst path, and keeps budget at least ceil(max(P50, worst path)) and at most 15; T14 then checks the day totals.
